policy: The local project includes 20 BreaKHis ResNet-18 and five scratch-CNN research checkpoints. Both workers passed generated-image CPU smoke checks in the existing local runtime. This does not demonstrate accuracy, clinical validity, or readiness for patient care. No CT, MRI, X-ray, mammography, or BRCA prediction models are included. Checkpoint redistribution is not cleared for source archives until all dataset-derived model terms are reviewed. This project is not for diagnosis or clinical use.
